title: Two Sane Nuts
writer: Géza von Cziffra, Theo Maria Werner, Gaetano Dell'Era
actors: Alberto Dell'Acqua, Wolf Goldan, Rinaldo Talamonti
plot: Two rival friends guide a young man through the Colombian jungle, hunting for, and finding a tribe of (not so) wild Amazons and a cache of (not so) bright emeralds.
